## Brown Peri-procedural Stroke Risk Assessment Tool

Estimates the probability of ischemic stroke within 30 days of a procedure from clinical history, procedure setting, and procedure category.

::: {.tool-evidence}
Validated across approximately 445,000 procedures at three hospitals · external-validation AUC **0.86**
:::

::: {.tool-actions}
[Open calculator ↗](https://liqi-shu.github.io/peri-procedural-stroke-calc/){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42261949/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

[View source code and locked model →](https://github.com/liqi-shu/peri-procedural-stroke-calc){.tool-source}
:::

::: {.tool-card}
::: {.tool-badge}
Live calculator · International validation

## DIAS³ Post-CVT Epilepsy Risk Calculator

Estimates individualized 1- and 3-year epilepsy risk after cerebral venous thrombosis from six acute-phase clinical and imaging variables.

::: {.tool-evidence}
Developed in 1,128 patients · externally validated in two independent cohorts
:::

::: {.tool-actions}
[Open DIAS³ calculator ↗](https://cerebralvenousthrombosis.com/professionals/dias-3/){.btn .btn-primary} [Read the paper](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39432281/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.tool-caution}
The CVT Consortium notes that this calculator is not CE marked and should be used with appropriate clinical caution.
:::
:::
:::
